message: No detected untrusted source handling: Data is fetched from S3 (via S3Manager) and MongoDB without any checksum verification, signed URL validation, or integrity checks on the retrieved data.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, label value validation, or label-noise detection tools are present anywhere in the code.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering is applied to training or production data during preparation.
No detected model integrity verification: The code loads model versions and transformer artifacts from MongoDB/S3 without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision validation.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks label distribution, class balance, or anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation-pattern analysis, trigger detection, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the pipeline code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) or related mechanisms are imported or used in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or attack methods (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are used anywhere in the code.
No detected metric tampering protection: The code contains no evaluation metrics, held-out test set isolation, signed/hashed evaluation data, or any mechanism to protect against metric manipulation.
No detected output bounds checks: No code is visible that checks model output values for NaN, out-of-range probabilities, or other sanity bounds before returning results to callers.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline handles embedding/projection tasks (not an LLM), so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
